playbookOutputs: SARS Tax Exemption Unit approval letter with PBO reference number (s30 approval)
Section 18A approval (where the activities qualify) with the s18A reference for donor receipts
Note on ongoing obligations (annual IT12EI return, s18A receipt format and annual s18A reporting, founding document restrictions)
playbookCommonFailures: Founding document (MOI / trust deed / constitution) lacks the compulsory s30(3) clauses — at least three unconnected fiduciaries, no distribution of surplus to members, dissolution clause transferring assets to another PBO
Activities described do not fall within the Ninth Schedule public benefit activities, or are described too vaguely for the TEU to classify
Organisation not yet registered for income tax (no tax number) so the EI1 cannot be linked
Certified IDs of office bearers older than 3 months or one fiduciary missing
Pack emailed to the wrong TEU mailbox or without the EI1 signed by an authorised office bearer — no acknowledgement ever arrives

informationToProvide.label: Certified Copy of the Organisation Founding Document (Signed NPC MOI, Trust Deed + Letters of Authority, or Signed Constitution)
alternatives: Trust deed with Master Letters of Authority
Signed constitution of a voluntary association
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the complete signed and certified founding document (NPC MOI, Trust Deed, or Constitution).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Complete, signed founding document: NPC MOI (with CIPC CoR14.3), trust deed plus Letters of Authority, or an association constitution. Check it contains the s30(3) clauses.

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) & DSD NPO Certificate (If Registered as an NPC / NPO)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate (and DSD NPO certificate if held).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 registration certificate of the Non-Profit Company.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID / Passport Copies (< 3 Months) for All Directors / Trustees / Office Bearers (Min 3 Unconnected Persons)
alternatives: Certified passport for foreign office bearers
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified ID copies (< 3 months) for all fiduciaries (at least 3 unconnected directors/trustees/office bearers).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address (< 3 Months) for All Fiduciaries (Directors / Trustees / Office Bearers)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of residential address (< 3 months) for each director/trustee/office bearer.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential street address dated within 90 days for every fiduciary.

informationToProvide.label: Fiduciaries Schedule — Full Names, Personal SARS Income Tax Numbers, Email Addresses & Cellphone Numbers for All 3+ Office Bearers
informationToProvide.helpText: List every director/trustee/office bearer with their full name, 10-digit personal SARS Income Tax number, email address, cellphone number, and confirm they are not connected persons (not related to each other).

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Address for the Organisation (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Letter from property owner + their utility bill
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of physical address (< 3 months) for the organisation.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the organisation physical address dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Valid Bank Confirmation Letter in the Name of the NPC / Trust / NPO (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload an official bank confirmation letter (< 3 months) in the organisation name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the NPC/Trust/NPO name dated within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Latest Audited / Reviewed Annual Financial Statements OR 12-Month Income & Expenditure Budget (for New Organisations)
alternatives: 12-month projected income & expenditure budget for a newly formed organisation
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your latest signed Annual Financial Statements, or a 12-month projected budget if newly formed.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed AFS for the last financial year or a 12-month projected income and expenditure budget.

informationToProvide.label: Organisation 10-Digit SARS Income Tax Reference Number & Primary Contact Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the organisation 10-digit SARS Income Tax reference number and primary telephone number.

informationToProvide.label: Detailed Narrative of Public Benefit Activities, Beneficiaries, Funding Sources & Whether Section 18A Donor Deductible Status Is Requested
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe in detail what activities the organisation performs, who the beneficiaries are, where activities take place, how they are funded, and whether you are also applying for Section 18A tax-deductible donor receipt approval.

informationToProvide.label: Signed SARS Form EI1, EI2 Written Undertaking & Special Power of Attorney (Once Drafted for Signature)
informationToProvide.helpText: Once we draft the SARS EI1 application, EI2 fiduciary undertaking, and Power of Attorney, have the three unconnected fiduciaries sign and upload the PDF pack here.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed SARS Form EI1, signed EI2 Written Undertaking signed by three unconnected fiduciaries, and signed SARS Power of Attorney.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect founding documents, activity description and office bearer IDs
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every required upload received, activities described in detail, s18A intention and funding sources answered
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why the Tax Exemption Unit needs it. Ask specifically: do they want s18A (donor tax-deductible receipts) — this needs Part II activities and specific founding-document wording; who funds them; whether they have a SARS tax number; and for programme evidence (reports, photos, website). Explain plainly that the TEU takes 60-90 working days and often longer — never promise shorter.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify founding document clauses, fiduciaries and activity mapping
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the founding document meets s30(3), at least three unconnected fiduciaries have certified IDs, and each activity maps to a Ninth Schedule PBA
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Agent pre-checks and Kevin confirms. s30(3)(b) clauses to look for: ≥3 unconnected persons with fiduciary responsibility; no single person controls decisions; funds used solely for the object; no distribution to members/employees beyond reasonable remuneration; on dissolution assets go to a similar PBO, government or institution; no remuneration excessive; amendments submitted to SARS (⚠ verify the current clause list against the SARS Tax Exemption Guide). If clauses are missing, stop and draft a client message: the MOI/constitution must be amended (offer the MOI amendment / CIPC special resolution service). Map activities to Part I paragraph numbers and, if s18A is sought, Part II.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft EI1 hand-off sheet, written motivation and cover letter
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: EI1 field values, a written motivation describing the activities against the Ninth Schedule, cover letter and POA drafted and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: EI1 (Application for exemption from income tax) fields: organisation details and tax number, entity type, founding document type, physical/postal address, fiduciaries with ID numbers, PBA paragraph numbers applied for, s18A yes/no with Part II paragraphs, funding sources, financial year end, bank details. Fill from verified facts only. The motivation is a factual description of each activity, beneficiaries, and funding with references to the attached evidence — no marketing language. POA authorises My Accountant to deal with the TEU. ⚠ verify the current EI1 form version on the SARS website before filling.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send EI1, motivation and POA to office bearers for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed EI1 (by an authorised office bearer), signed motivation and POA uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Plain instructions: an authorised office bearer signs and dates the EI1 and POA; initial each page of the founding document copy where certification requires it; return as PDF. Name which pages need a commissioner of oaths if the template requires it.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Email application pack to the SARS Tax Exemption Unit
fulfillmentChecklist.expectedReply: TEU acknowledgement email with a case/reference number
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Pack sent and TEU acknowledgement received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Attach: signed EI1, certified founding document, CoR14.3 / Letters of Authority, certified IDs of all fiduciaries, proof of address, AFS or budget, activity motivation with evidence, POA. Keep total attachment size within SARS mailbox limits (split into numbered parts if needed). ⚠ CONFIRM ADDRESS WITH KEVIN — plan §4 marks the channel ⚠: SARS may require submission via eFiling (Tax Exemption / SARS Online Query System) instead of or in addition to the teu@sars.gov.za mailbox; check current TEU guidance before first use.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for TEU decision and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: PBO approval letter (with PBO reference and, where applied for, s18A approval) or a TEU query received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a polite status-request email quoting the TEU reference at each follow-up point (TEU contact centre as an alternative). If the TEU raises a query (commonly: founding document amendments, clearer activity descriptions, confirmation of unconnected fiduciaries), create a proposal for Kevin with the query text and the documents it concerns, and a plain client message with what to supply. If a founding document amendment is required, route to the CIPC special resolution / MOI amendment service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver PBO approval letter and compliance note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Approval letter, PBO/s18A reference numbers and obligations note posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain in plain English: annual IT12EI income tax return is still required; s18A receipts must contain the prescribed details and reference number and annual s18A donation reporting to SARS applies (⚠ verify current third-party data submission requirement); any change to the founding document must be sent to the TEU; trading income above the thresholds may be taxable. Offer the annual IT12EI and AFS services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
